_comment: Accepted npm-audit exceptions for the SAST gate (scripts/security/sast-scan.sh).
This file is the machine-readable mirror of client/SECURITY_EXCEPTIONS.md.
A high/critical advisory only stops blocking the deploy if its package name is
listed here. Any high/critical finding on a package NOT listed here still fails
the gate, so newly introduced production vulnerabilities are caught.
Keep this in sync with client/SECURITY_EXCEPTIONS.md; review quarterly.

acceptedPackages.name: react-scripts
acceptedPackages.reason: CRA build tool. Transitive build/test toolchain vulns are not in the shipped bundle; only fix is a breaking react-scripts@0.0.0 downgrade. SECURITY_EXCEPTIONS.md #2.
